message.content: {"caption":"Workflow diagram of a framework that turns model–environment interactions into reusable skills and uses them to improve an agent.","description":"The diagram shows a base model interacting with an environment to generate trajectories, which are divided into successful episodes and lessons from failure and stored in memory. The memory feeds a skill library containing general and task-specific skills, with guidance to use available skills, explore unvisited nodes, and refine skills for cleaning tasks. A cold-start supervised fine-tuning model uses the skills while interacting with the environment; reinforcement-learning updates evolve the model and update the skill bank, with options to create or refine skills.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
